name: CPI Headline YoY % (annual average)
notes: World Bank / ILO annual average CPI inflation. Annual tier-1 fallback for the monthly <C>_CPI_YOY columns (cadence-first means any monthly source wins by frequency; WB only fills countries with no monthly source). >2% = above DM central bank targets; >5% = high-inflation regime. Renamed CPI->CPI_YOY 2026-07-07 (CPI-definition split — see manuals/2026-06-18-source-wiring-audit-proposal.md (Resolution section)). [2026-07-30] Renamed CPI_YOY -> CPI_YOY_ANNUAL and recorded as its own series. This is the YoY change of the ANNUAL AVERAGE index, a different construction from the mean of 12 monthly YoY prints — owner decision: record them separately rather than splice. Measured divergence against the monthly siblings under a mean aggregation: JPN 0.18pp, CHN 0.28pp, GBR 1.13pp, DEU 1.76pp. Previously this row contested <ISO>_CPI_YOY and was floor-blocked by the C15 cadence floor on every country that has a monthly source, so its data was discarded; under its own column it is retained. No column loses its serving source: all 11 <ISO>_CPI_YOY are served monthly. See forward_plan §2.C C16.1.
